LanguageData.RSR.Issue.UseRestaurantCooking: Use “cook restaurant order”; stove bills do not represent customer orders
LanguageData.RSR.UI.RegisterProductHint: Register extra goods using the same rules as regular cabinets, including non-food items. Set stock targets and sale status, then save. Non-edible goods default to takeaway.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.StockOnlyFood: No supported single-product cooking recipe. Choose Sell from stock under Add dish, or list this item in a food or drinks cabinet.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.StockMenuEditorHint: Select a sales cabinet in this shop and a product. Saving updates the cabinet and menu immediately.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.StockMenuNote: Waiters collect actual items from this cabinet; no cooking recipe is required. Cabinets restock from shelves in this shop. A stock target of 0 disables automatic restocking. Listed products appear on the menu and can be ordered when enough stock is available. Saving applies immediately; cancel or close to discard this edit.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.NoStockCabinetHint: Build and select a cupboard, wine cabinet or sundries cabinet inside this shop. Refrigerators supply kitchen ingredients.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.SelectStockFoodHint: Select the product to sell from stock.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.SelectStockProductHint: Choose a product allowed by this cabinet. Search or filter by source mod. No cooking recipe is required; saving registers the product.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.InvalidStockTarget: The stock target must be an integer from 0 to {capacity}. Combined targets must fit within the cabinet capacity.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.NoUsableRecipe: No currently usable workbench or recipe in this restaurant can make this dish.
LanguageData.RSR.UI.AutoIngredientsMissing: Not enough stock for the minimum order size. Missing recipe ingredients: {ingredient}
LanguageData.RSR.UI.AutoIngredientsDone: Ingredients selected from available stock. Supplies in colony storage must be restocked into this restaurant’s refrigerator before cooking.
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.ExportHint: Share the current menu and operating settings. Staff, buildings, inventory and active orders are excluded.
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.ImportHint: Paste the shared text. Import replaces the current settings draft; save in shop management to apply it, or close that window to discard it.
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.Imported: Settings imported into the draft. Save in shop management to apply them.
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.MissingDef: This game is missing an item definition: {def}
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.InvalidDish: Invalid recipe, price, portion count or ingredients for dish: {dish}
LanguageData.RSR.Transfer.InvalidParameters: Operating settings are outside the allowed ranges.
